home.footerNote: Fix60 connects you with verified home-help providers in Kerala.

safety.title: Your safety comes first
safety.verifiedBody: Every provider's ID and documents are checked by our team before they can take bookings.
safety.privacyBody: Your phone number and exact address are shared only after you confirm a provider.
safety.reportBody: Something feels wrong? Report or block a provider from their profile or booking. Our safety team reviews every report.

browse.title: Find a service
browse.label: Search services
browse.emptyBody: Try a different word, or browse the categories on the home screen.

category.emptyBody: Services in this category will appear here soon.

steps.postBody: Choose the date, time, hours and any special requirements.
steps.acceptBody: Verified providers near you see your request and accept if they're free.
steps.chooseBody: Compare who accepted and confirm one. Contact details are shared only then.
steps.reviewBody: After the service, mark it completed and rate your provider.

service.checksVerified: Identity and documents verified by the Fix60 team

form.introQuick: Tell us what you need. We'll invite verified providers nearby and you choose from those who accept.
form.introDirected: Your request goes to this provider only. If they can't make it, you can post a quick request.
form.areaNotePlaceholder: e.g. Near St. Mary's church, Kakkanad
form.areaNoteHint: Your exact address is shared only after you confirm a provider.
form.durationHint: Need full-day or monthly help? Say so in the requirements below.
form.budgetHint: Per hour, in rupees. Leave empty to see providers' own rates.
form.requirementsPlaceholder: e.g. 2 bedrooms, vegetarian cooking, elderly parent needs help walking
form.safetyBody: Requests for anything illegal, unsafe or outside the service are not allowed. Requests are reviewed, and accounts that break the rules are suspended.
form.contactPhoneHint: Your registered number. Shared with the provider only after you confirm.
